body.message:
Hi Chahana,

Thank you for your message.

My friend and I are looking for either a studio with a kitchen or a 1-bedroom apartment with a kitchen.

Our preferred location is as close as possible to the University of Europe for Applied Sciences (UE Dubai), near the Museum of the Future, World Trade Centre, DIFC, Al Satwa, Al Jafiliya, or Jumeirah Garden City.

Our move-in date is 1 September 2026.

We are planning to stay for 9–12 months.

Our budget is AED 4,000–4,500 per month for two people.

Please send us any suitable options.

Thank you!
